output.explanation:
The central tree shrinks from 114 to 75 lines (34.2%) and from 8,920 to 5,737 characters (35.7%). It retains modular boundaries, call paths, ownership and cross-cutting data dependencies. Four peripheral trees expand meaningful concepts: request submission, edit preparation, transcript delivery and isolated candidate state. M = modular structure, C = call, O = ownership, D = data dependency. Positions leave gaps between actual text rectangles; edges use 1-based raw lines.

Only context.json and seed.json supplied evidence. Source-grounded corrections and qualifications: agentChatRoutes.ts:8-27,54-90 limits tool previews to SSE snapshots, rather than all session responses; its generation projection removes history but leaves inputHistory. generationCanvasBridge.ts:33-89 implements only a subset of CanvasSessionPort, including restricted view behavior. AgentChatService.finishGeneration at agentChatService.ts:319-340 saves the terminal child before entering the synchronization try/finally, so the seed's cleanup statement is conditional: failure of that save can bypass cleanup. startTurn at :410-459 records request IDs before submission without removing them on failure; duplicate suppression does not establish successful execution.

Additional details absent from the seed include SSE backlog allowance and preview thresholds, subtree-selection completeness checks, preparation-cache limits, transport-derived projection retry identity, and mutation receipts retained before persistence. These come from agentChatRoutes.ts:23-90, chatDiagramTools.ts:75-112,216-267, and generationCanvasBridge.ts:40-91. Panel retry and stream ownership follow AgentChatPanel.tsx:140-217.

Uncertainty: imported implementations such as ChatStore, ChatStream, the controller and evaluation observer are not supplied. Their internals are not inferred. Lifecycle failure observations describe visible control flow, not experimentally reproduced failures.

Agent Chat Orchestration
|-- [M] Modular structure: interactive chat + independent canvas alternatives
|   |-- Client boundary: AgentChatPanel -> HTTP actions + SSE subscription
|   |   |-- Exposes conversations, settings, Send, Read Canvas, Stop and answers
|   |   `-- Keeps tabs, drafts, retry identities and ChatStream instance in the client
|   |-- Application boundary: routes -> AgentChatService
|   |   |-- Exposes sessions, turns, tool dispatch, generation and event subscription
|   |   `-- Keeps session/thread indexes, pending requests and concurrency guards internal
|   |-- AgentChatService -> injected capabilities
|   |   |-- ChatStore persists sessions; CodexConnection carries app-server RPC/events
|   |   |-- ChatCanvasReader reads context; ChatMcpBinding binds conversation tools
|   |   |-- ChatTools -> ChatDiagramTools -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |   |   `-- Exposes edits, views, highlights, projections and saved-context operations
|   |   `-- Generation bridge + context-library read + observer supply child inputs/results
|   `-- GenerationCanvasBridge implements CanvasSessionPort
|       |-- Live canvas ID -> delegate; generation canvas ID -> private controller
|       `-- Isolated implementation supports a subset; invalid bindings/operations fail
|-- [C] Interactive conversation: caller -> invocation -> result
|   |-- Create -> thread/start with chat instructions/tools -> save session
|   |-- Resume -> reuse local session or import native thread once
|   |   `-- Import rejects active thread; retains native history; starts without canvas tools
|   |-- Send / Read Canvas -> startTurn
|   |   |-- Known request ID returns; running/starting/reloading turn rejects
|   |   |-- Resume if needed -> capture canvas/references -> bind tools
|   |   `-- Save request ID before turn/start; send text or read_canvas tool output
|   |-- App-server messages -> receive -> thread ID resolves owning chat
|   |   |-- Deltas merge/flush, normally after 32 ms; reducer updates session/listeners
|   |   |-- SSE snapshot/parts + live events -> ChatStream -> panel transcript
|   |   `-- Questions/approvals -> pending request -> answer -> connection.respond
|   |-- turn/completed -> settle open items/pending requests -> save terminal state
|   |-- Tool invocation -> dispatchTool
|   |   |-- Native call checks active turn; HTTP binding requires running chat with tools
|   |   |-- gen-alternatives -> managed child generation
|   |   `-- Other tools -> access/target/revision checks -> agent API
|   `-- Idle reload -> resume same thread with MCP -> verify inventory -> save definitions
|-- [C] Generate alternatives: one request -> independently scheduled child turns
|   |-- Require writable parent, tools, user message and source canvas; reject nesting
|   |-- Request ID + signature -> reuse receipt or reject conflicting arguments
|   |-- Read optional saved AgentContext -> allocate run/candidate IDs
|   |   `-- Persist child records + parent receipt -> start source views -> retain history
|   |-- Schedule launchGeneration for each child with its own thread and binding
|   |   |-- Saved context -> thread/start + inject captured reference data
|   |   |-- Otherwise -> thread/fork before active parent turn or through retained last turn
|   |   `-- Clear inherited goal -> add isolated controller -> start one managed turn
|   |-- finishGeneration -> classify finished/failed/cancelled -> retain child history
|   |   |-- Publish observer update -> synchronize candidate view on source canvas
|   |   `-- Only finished results apply history; failed sync is retried by generations query
|   `-- Evaluation rerun -> same executor with retained source history/settings
|       `-- Reconnect source by stable workspace identity if live canvas ID changed
|-- [O] Responsibility and lifetime
|   |-- AgentChatService retains sessions, request receipts and child histories
|   |   |-- Closing a UI tab keeps the conversation; Stop cancels children then parent turn
|   |   `-- Restart interrupts running chats/items and marks active generations failed
|   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge owns one controller per active candidate
|   |   |-- Captured history + fresh context ID; serialized commands + mutation receipts
|   |   `-- Mutations export history through callback -> persist child session
|   |-- Generation settlement cleanup -> clear binding, remove controller, unsubscribe
|   |   `-- Cleanup follows terminal child save; retained history outlives controller
|   |-- StdioCodexConnection owns app-server process, pending RPCs and 30-second timers
|   |   `-- Process loss rejects RPCs; service clears bindings and fails active work
|   `-- SSE response owns heartbeat/subscription; panel owns EventSource/ChatStream
|       `-- Response close or panel selection cleanup releases the corresponding resources
`-- [D] Data dependency: inputs needed to compute results
    |-- Prepared diagram edit
    |   |-- Arguments + captured canvas/references -> target and base revision
    |   `-- Current snapshot + validated anchors + attached session -> submitDirect input
    |-- Candidate result history
    |   |-- Shared captured source history -> initial state of each isolated controller
    |   |-- Shared task + candidate prompt + model/effort + saved context OR fork history
    |   `-- Candidate mutations -> its exported history; siblings evolve independently
    |-- Candidate token usage
    |   `-- Reported total minus baseline, once complete last-request usage is available
    `-- Published generation result
        |-- Child terminal metadata + retained history + source identity + candidate view ID
        `-- Children sharing runId + parent session -> optional evaluation observer

Turn submission and retry boundaries
|-- [O/D] Panel retains pending request bodies after uncertain responses
|   |-- Send signature: text + references + canvas
|   |-- Matching signature reuses body, including original settings and requestId
|   |-- Read Canvas retry matches workspace/document and reuses captured body
|   `-- ChatRequestError clears pending entry; other failures retain it
|-- [C] startTurn admission
|   |-- Known requestId returns before busy checks
|   `-- Running/starting/reloading guard rejects a new request
|-- [C/D] Prepare -> record -> issue turn/start
|   |-- Read Canvas obtains complete short context as read_canvas tool output
|   |-- Capture canvas/references; bind MCP when canvas tools apply
|   |-- Append requestId -> save session -> call app-server
|   `-- Failure marks chat failed; appended requestId is not removed
|       `-- Same-ID retry suppresses submission; it does not prove execution
|-- [M] Two paths into dispatchTool
|   |-- Native: allowed tool + no namespace + running + matching known turn ID
|   |-- HTTP: valid token + running + canvasTools + not reloading + allowed tool
|   `-- Context is cloned; transport call ID is paired with turn ID
`-- [C] Reload preserves thread while replacing available MCP tools
    |-- Idle guard -> temporary definition snapshot -> unsubscribe/resume
    |-- config/mcpServer/reload -> verify every chat_<name> in mapping inventory
    |-- Inject updated developer guidance -> persist definitions + canvasTools
    `-- Native dynamic tool definitions remain fixed at thread/start

Preparing an edit from captured references
|-- [M] ChatDiagramTools adapts chat inputs to the agent API
|   |-- edit/create/extend accept batches of 1..20 operations
|   `-- Read-only access rejects these mutations before preparation
|-- [D] Resolve each operation against one current document snapshot
|   |-- Exactly one of reference or nodeId is required
|   |-- Reference index -> captured canvas + display ID + revision
|   |-- Otherwise use turn canvas; all batch operations share one document
|   |-- Cached canvas attachment -> session ID -> resolve argument aliases
|   `-- Snapshot -> diagram existence, identity and base revision checks
|       |-- Explicit base revision must agree with selected reference
|       `-- Stale/missing base revision rejects; errors identify operations[index]
|-- [D] Selected nodes -> complete subtree replacement targets
|   |-- Derive selected roots whose parents are not selected
|   |-- Expand root ranges; expanded members must exactly equal selection
|   |-- Reject mixing reference selection with explicit contentNodeIds
|   |-- Whole-diagram mode rejects subtree targets
|   `-- Resolve anchors + replacement ranges before submission
|-- [C] Prepared operations + snapshot.version + attachment
|   `-- submitDirect -> returned runId -> remember owning chat
|-- [O] Prepared edit requests live in an in-memory map
|   |-- Key: [chat ID, requestId]; signature: tool name + parsed input
|   |-- Identical retry reuses preparation; changed arguments reject
|   |-- Preparation failure removes entry; capacity is 500 entries
|   `-- Status/cancel require the remembered run owner; restart loses ownership
`-- [M] Projection uses a different retry identity
    `-- Transport toolCallId identifies request; prepared payload pins version/UUID

Transcript delivery and public visibility
|-- [C] AgentChatService -> reducer -> subscribed listeners
|   |-- Adjacent deltas with matching item ID/kind are concatenated
|   |-- Timer flushes after 32 ms; large bursts can flush sooner
|   `-- Non-delta messages and get() flush queued deltas first
|-- [M] Routes project public sessions and events
|   |-- Session projection omits toolDefinitions and generationRequests
|   |-- Generation projection removes history only; inputHistory remains
|   `-- Snapshot/state/batch events pass through that projection
|-- [D] SSE snapshots use bounded tool previews
|   |-- Only non-inProgress tool items are candidates
|   |-- Text > 1000 chars OR any diff > 1000 chars triggers preview
|   |-- Text: last 3 lines; each diff: first 3; each line <= 240 chars
|   |-- Item endpoint returns full item; ordinary session GET is not previewed
|   `-- More than one item -> empty partial snapshot + one item per part
|-- [O] Each SSE response retains its own transport resources
|   |-- Identity encoding + flushed headers; heartbeat every 15 seconds
|   |-- Snapshot bytes receive a temporary backlog allowance
|   |-- Queued bytes > allowance + 2 MiB -> destroy response
|   `-- Response close -> clear heartbeat and unsubscribe
`-- [C/O] AgentChatPanel owns active EventSource + ChatStream
    |-- Parsed events -> buffer.receive; stream visibility follows panel open state
    |-- Selection/attempt change -> close EventSource and dispose buffer
    |-- Running inactive tabs -> refresh summaries every 2500 ms while open
    `-- ChatStream assembly internals are outside the supplied source

Isolated candidate state and publication
|-- [D/O] launchGeneration -> GenerationCanvasBridge.add
|   |-- Captured history -> document + head view + fresh context ID
|   |-- Generation ID doubles as canvas identity and document ID
|   `-- Entry retains controller, persistence callback, receipts and promise queue
|-- [M] Dispatch boundary
|   |-- Known generation ID requires exact document binding
|   |-- Unknown generation-* ID fails; other IDs delegate to live port
|   |-- Reads: identity, context, document-state, read and snapshot
|   |-- Writes: apply, diagram batch/revision, create and diagram-context
|   |-- canvas-view: list returns empty saved map; save acknowledges current state
|   `-- Other view operations fail; checkpoint verifies expectedVersion
|-- [C/O] Per-controller queue serializes dispatch
|   |-- Mutation requires requestId; receipt key is method + requestId
|   |-- Changed full-command signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |-- First application stores receipt before awaiting persistence
|   |-- Retry reuses result and retries history persistence without applying again
|   `-- Queue catches rejection so subsequent commands can still run
|-- [D] Batch/revision result includes unresolvedEdgeIds
|   `-- Validate anchors after apply; report invalid connections in returned result
|-- [C/O] finishGeneration retains output before source synchronization
|   |-- Cancelled metadata or interrupted chat -> cancelled; idle -> finished
|   |-- Other chat states -> failed; controller history falls back to retained history
|   |-- Terminal child save occurs before synchronization try/finally
|   |-- Sync failure retains result; finally clears binding/controller/subscription
|   `-- A failure of that earlier save can bypass this cleanup block
`-- [D] Publication joins retained child result to source view
    |-- Stable workspace recovery requires exactly one matching live document
    |-- Finished publishes history; failed/cancelled publishes terminal metadata
    |-- Observer failures are caught; evaluation internals are not supplied
    `-- generations() retries unsynced terminal results and reports pendingSave
